place.name: barely awake
place.description: The sun pokes through the blinds, stinging your. You sink comfortably into a pile of mostly clean laundry on your bed as you reacquaint yourself with consciousness.

place.name: Bathroom
place.description: It's good to wash up every few weeks. Toilet, sink, shower, mirror, window. Yep, everyone is here. Why is there a window in the bathroom? In the mirror, you notice your screenface is a bit blurry this morning, and your skirt is a bit crumpled. Your bow sticker is still glossy on the corner of your face, and your sweater has no loose threads, so you're presentable enough for the day.

place.name: Bedroom
place.description: This place is a mess, but it's your mess. On the north side of the room, your alarm clock blinks 12:00 on the nightstand. You doubt it can actually tell time. Abandond craft projects are strewn about on the floor like dirty laundry, which is also strewn about the floor. On a row of hooks hanging on the door to the hallway, you see your daily essentials: Backpack, purses, belts, corsets, rechargeable emp burst device, cleaning cloth, and cleansing spray. The windowsill is patterned with marks in permanent marker that are going to become the start of a 360-degree mural. Someday.
